title: Post Turnaround Bank Shot
description: From a post catch, the player turns to face the baseline side and uses the backboard for a short turnaround jumper.

content.objective: Catch in the post, turn on balance toward the baseline and bank a short jumper off the square.
content.setup: Passer at the wing; post player on the block with back to the basket.
instructions: Seal on the block and show a target with the outside hand.
Catch with two hands and chin the ball.
Front-pivot on the inside foot toward the baseline to face the rim at an angle.
Rise and aim at the top near corner of the square.
coachingPoints: Use the board from the angle.
commonMistakes: Fading away and leaving the shot short.
Turning into the middle, where help defenders are.
content.safety: Shooters rebound their own ball only when the lane is clear; nobody stands under the rim while others shoot.
progressions: Shot fake after the turn and step through.
regressions: No jump: set shot off the board.
variations: Turn to the middle and shoot a hook.
successCriteria: Seven of ten made from each block.
content.gameApplication: Post players who can turn and score keep defenders honest when they double the ball.
